rv.q: Want to know more about Avenue Q? Here's everything you need to know about this beloved musical. If you're interested in seeing more theatre revivals, here's all the must-see revivals playing in London in 2026.

As filthy, funny and gloriously sharp as ever, this revival understands exactly why the show endures, and with a limited run here at the Shaftesbury, forget Sesame Street, you need to be asking how to get to Avenue Q.
Thankfully, the show still packs a wallop and resonates with current audiences, primarily because the inherent truth in their lyrics hasn't changed.
